acceptance: Unchanged independent deterministic 2x200 ground episodes; no expert prefix or BC assistance at evaluation.
identity: pure PPO noise-only control, no teacher/BC/reward change

at_25_or_50: Stop if latest completed training episode batch has zero qualified-flight events and body-contact rate exceeds 50%.

Stop if zero qualified-flight events and behavior mean-outside-bounds fraction is at least 0.10 above the preregistered pre-diagnostic mean-policy baseline; require at least 128 completed training episodes.
Always stop at 50 updates. No automatic further revision; report insufficient evidence when the batch is too small.
stopping_rules.interpretation: Training stochastic rates are not acceptance. Run the fixed post-diagnostic and 400-episode formal evaluation once on the last safe checkpoint, even if the pilot was stopped for failure; numerical failure requires repair before rollout.

snapshots: Retain named checkpoint_000025.pt and checkpoint_000050.pt; these are the existing canonical-reset checkpoints copied without another env reset.
